EmailTemplate.name: Donor Approval
EmailTemplate.subject: Donor Agreement - {!Donor_Agreement__c.Name} for Your Review
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Donor_Agreement__c.Donor__r.Name},
We hope you are doing well.
Thank you for your interest in supporting our program. Please review your donor agreement details below:
--------------------------------------------------
Agreement Details:
Agreement Name: {!Donor_Agreement__c.Agreement_Name__c} Program: {!Donor_Agreement__c.Program__c} Total Amount: {!Donor_Agreement__c.Total_Amount__c} Start Date: {!Donor_Agreement__c.Start_Date__c} End Date: {!Donor_Agreement__c.End_Date__c} Funding Purpose: {!Donor_Agreement__c.Funding_Purpose__c}
--------------------------------------------------
Please review the agreement and choose one of the options below:
Accept Agreement: https://orgfarm-4e9caeff63-dev-ed.develop.lightning.force.com/flow/Donor_Response_Flow?recordId={!Donor_Agreement__c.Id}&response=Accepted
Reject Agreement: https://orgfarm-4e9caeff63-dev-ed.develop.lightning.force.com/flow/Donor_Response_Flow?recordId={!Donor_Agreement__c.Id}&response=Rejected
--------------------------------------------------
If you have any questions, please feel free to contact us.
Thank you for your support.
Best regards, CSM Technologies
